products.name: Dataiku
products.note: Collaborative data science platform; MLOps; governance workflows; EU-hosted options; GDPR relevant

profile_text.body:
Dataiku describes itself as "the Platform for AI Success," positioning its core product as a unified system for enterprise AI that combines people, data orchestration, and governance workflows. The platform is designed to move organizations away from manual processes such as spreadsheets and legacy desktop tools, and toward governed, AI-assisted data pipelines that support everything from data preparation to model deployment and MLOps. The company offers EU-hosted options and describes its governance capabilities as applying consistently across AI activity both inside and outside the platform, with features including unified visibility, cost controls, and audit-ready oversight.

The company cites several enterprise deployments on its site, including Novartis using the Dataiku LLM Mesh for healthcare market research, Johnson and Johnson's Vision team building generative AI prototypes in under two days through a Dataiku-led hackathon, and Michelin scaling AI across more than 50 global manufacturing sites. Dataiku also references a joint survey with Harris Poll of 900 CEOs across eight global markets, finding that 80 percent of CEOs say their role is at risk if their company fails to deliver measurable AI gains by the end of 2026. For the fifth consecutive year, Dataiku reports being named a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for AI Platforms for Data Science and ML, recognized in both the "Completeness of Vision" and "Ability to Execute" categories.
